function FieldSeparator({
  children,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  children?: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="field-separator"
      data-content={!!children}
      className={cn(
        "relative -my-2 h-5 text-sm group-data-[variant=outline]/field-group:-mb-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <Separator className="absolute inset-0 top-1/2" />
      {children && (
        <span
          className="bg-background text-muted-foreground relative mx-auto block w-fit px-2"
          data-slot="field-separator-content"
        >
          {children}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function FieldError({
  className,
  children,
  errors,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  errors?: Array<{ message?: string } | undefined>
}) {
  const content = useMemo(() => {
    if (children) {
      return children
    }

    if (!errors) {
      return null
    }

    if (errors?.length === 1 && errors[0]?.message) {
      return errors[0].message
    }

    return (
      <ul className="ml-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1">
        {errors.map(
          (error, index) =>
            error?.message && <li key={index}>{error.message}</li>
        )}
      </ul>
    )
  }, [children, errors])

  if (!content) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      data-slot="field-error"
      className={cn("text-destructive text-sm font-normal", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {content}
    </div>
  )
}

export {
  Field,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
  FieldContent,
  FieldTitle,
}


##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/components/ui/form.tsx
import * as React from "react"
import * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import {
  Controller,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
  type ControllerProps,
  type FieldPath,
  type FieldValues,
} from "react-hook-form"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
> = {
  name: TName
}

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue | null>(null)

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  )
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext()

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  if (!itemContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormItem>")
  }

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue | null>(null)

const FormItem = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div ref={ref} className={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...props} />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  )
})
FormItem.displayName = "FormItem"

const FormLabel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Label
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(error && "text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormLabel.displayName = "FormLabel"

const FormControl = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Slot>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof Slot>
>(({ ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <Slot
      ref={ref}
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormControl.displayName = "FormControl"

const FormDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-[0.8rem] text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
})
FormDescription.displayName = "FormDescription"

const FormMessage = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message ?? "") : children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <p
      ref={ref}
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-[0.8rem] font-medium text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  )
})
FormMessage.displayName = "FormMessage"

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"

function ItemGroup({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      role="list"
      data-slot="item-group"
      className={cn("group/item-group flex flex-col", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function ItemSeparator({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Separator>) {
  return (
    <Separator
      data-slot="item-separator"
      orientation="horizontal"
      className={cn("my-0", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

const itemVariants = cva(
  "group/item [a]:hover:bg-accent/50 focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 [a]:transition-colors flex flex-wrap items-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-sm outline-none transition-colors duration-100 focus-visible:ring-[3px]",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-transparent",
        outline: "border-border",
        muted: "bg-muted/50",
      },
      size: {
        default: "gap-4 p-4 ",
        sm: "gap-2.5 px-4 py-3",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Item({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
  VariantProps<typeof itemVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "div"
  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="item"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(itemVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { cva, VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { PanelLeftIcon } from "lucide-react"

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

type SidebarContextProps = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  open: boolean
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  openMobile: boolean
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  isMobile: boolean
  toggleSidebar: () => void
}

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContextProps | null>(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  const open = openProp ?? _open
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState)
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState)
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  )

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      isMobile,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
  )

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          className={cn(
            "group/sidebar-wrapper has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar flex min-h-svh w-full",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  )
}

function Sidebar({
  side = "left",
  variant = "sidebar",
  collapsible = "offcanvas",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  side?: "left" | "right"
  variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
  collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
}) {
  const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

  if (collapsible === "none") {
    return (
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar"
        className={cn(
          "bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex h-full w-[var(--sidebar-width)] flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
        <SheetContent
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar"
          data-mobile="true"
          className="bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground w-[var(--sidebar-width)] p-0 [&>button]:hidden"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          side={side}
        >
          <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
            <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
            <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
          </SheetHeader>
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="group peer text-sidebar-foreground hidden md:block"
      data-state={state}
      data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-side={side}
      data-slot="sidebar"
    >
      {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-gap"
        className={cn(
          "relative w-[var(--sidebar-width)] bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
          "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
          "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+var(--spacing-4))]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)]"
        )}
      />
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-container"
        className={cn(
          "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-[var(--sidebar-width)] transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear md:flex",
          side === "left"
            ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
            : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
          // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+var(--spacing-4)+2px)]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)] group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar-inner"
          className="bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border flex h-full w-full flex-col group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow-sm"
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function SidebarTrigger({
  className,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <Button
      data-sidebar="trigger"
      data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className={cn("h-7 w-7", className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event)
        toggleSidebar()
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeftIcon />
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle Sidebar</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

function SidebarRail({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"button">) {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  // Note: Tailwind v3.4 doesn't support "in-" selectors. So the rail won't work perfectly.
  return (
    <button
      data-sidebar="rail"
      data-slot="sidebar-rail"
      aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
      tabIndex={-1}
      onClick={toggleSidebar}
      title="Toggle Sidebar"
      className={cn(
        "hover:after:bg-sidebar-border absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 -translate-x-1/2 transition-all ease-linear group-data-[side=left]:-right-4 group-data-[side=right]:left-0 after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-[2px] sm:flex",
        "in-data-[side=left]:cursor-w-resize in-data-[side=right]:cursor-e-resize",
        "[[data-side=left][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-e-resize [[data-side=right][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-w-resize",
        "hover:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:bg-sidebar group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:translate-x-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:after:left-full",
        "[[data-side=left][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-right-2",
        "[[data-side=right][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-left-2",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

const sidebarMenuButtonVariants = cva(
  "peer/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md p-2 text-left text-sm outline-hidden ring-sidebar-ring transition-[width,height,padding] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-sidebar-accent active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-has-data-[sidebar=menu-action]/menu-item:pr-8 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 data-[active=true]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[active=true]:font-medium data-[active=true]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:hover:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-8! group-data-[collapsible=icon]:h-8! group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-2! [&>span:last-child]:truncate [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        outline:
          "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-border))] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_hsl(var(--sidebar-accent))]",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-8 text-sm",
        sm: "h-7 text-xs",
        lg: "h-12 text-sm group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-0!",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function SidebarMenuButton({
  asChild = false,
  isActive = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  tooltip,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  isActive?: boolean
  tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
} & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
  const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

  const button = (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
      data-sidebar="menu-button"
      data-size={size}
      data-active={isActive}
      className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )

  if (!tooltip) {
    return button
  }

  if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
    tooltip = {
      children: tooltip,
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent
        side="right"
        align="center"
        hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
        {...tooltip}
      />
    </Tooltip>
  )
}

function SidebarMenuSkeleton({

  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {

}) {

    return `${Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 50}%`
  }, [])

  return (
    <div
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-skeleton"
      data-sidebar="menu-skeleton"
      className={cn("flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {showIcon && (
        <Skeleton
          className="size-4 rounded-md"
          data-sidebar="menu-skeleton-icon"
        />
      )}
      <Skeleton
        className="h-4 max-w-[var(--skeleton-width)] flex-1"
        data-sidebar="menu-skeleton-text"
        style={
          {
            "--skeleton-width": width,
          } as React.CSSProperties
        }
      />
    </div>
  )
}

##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/components/ui/switch.tsx
import * as React from "react"
import * as SwitchPrimitives from "@radix-ui/react-switch"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const Switch = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SwitchPrimitives.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SwitchPrimitives.Root>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (

import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast"
import {
  Toast,
  ToastClose,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastViewport,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast()

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && (
                <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>
              )}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        )
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  )
}

##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}


##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/hooks/use-toast.ts
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
      toast: ToasterToast
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
    }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/pages/ComissaoFechamento.tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const API = "/api/config";

type SubPage = "comissoes" | "metas" | "config";

interface Colaboradora {
  id: string;
  nome: string;
  classificacao: "A" | "B" | "C";
  ativo: boolean;
  apelidos: string[];
}

interface EventoComissao { tipo: string; descricao: string; valor: number; }

interface FechamentoSemanalRow {
  id: string;
  semana_inicio: string;
  semana_fim: string;
  colaboradora_id: string;
  detalhamento: EventoComissao[];
  valor_total: number;
  meta_equipe_batida: boolean;
  status_pagamento: "pendente" | "pago" | "parcial";
  valor_faltante: number | null;
  observacao_pagamento: string | null;
  colaboradoras: { nome: string; classificacao: string };
}

interface MetasConfig {
  meta_equipe_semanal_qtd: number;
  meta_equipe_semanal_valor: number;
  meta_presencial_baixa_qtd: number;
  meta_presencial_baixa_valor: number;
  meta_presencial_alta_qtd: number;
  meta_presencial_alta_valor: number;
  meta_online_baixa_qtd: number;
  meta_online_baixa_valor: number;
  meta_online_alta_qtd: number;
  meta_online_alta_valor: number;
}

function formatBRL(v: number): string {
  return (v || 0).toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" });
}

function getMondayISO(d: Date): string {
  const date = new Date(d);
  const dia = date.getDay();
  const diff = dia === 0 ? -6 : 1 - dia;
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + diff);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function addDaysISO(iso: string, dias: number): string {
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + dias);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function fmtDataCurta(iso: string): string {
  const p = iso.split("-");
  return p.length === 3 ? `${p[2]}/${p[1]}` : iso;
}

const STATUS_CFG: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; bg: string }> = {
  pendente: { label: "Pendente", color: "#d97706", bg: "#fef3c7" },
  pago: { label: "Pago", color: "#059669", bg: "#d1fae5" },
  parcial: { label: "Pago parcial", color: "#dc2626", bg: "#fef2f2" },
};

const TIPO_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  agendamento: "Agendamento",
  combo_protection: "Combo Protection",
  combo_premium: "Combo Premium",
  acessorio_avulso: "Acessório avulso",
  aparelho_acima_tabela: "Aparelho acima da tabela",
  aparelho_joana: "Aparelho vendido (bônus Joana)",
  adq: "Bônus ADQ (follow up)",
  meta_equipe: "Meta de equipe",
};

function agruparEventos(eventos: EventoComissao[]) {
  const grupos = new Map<string, { label: string; qtd: number; total: number }>();
  for (const ev of eventos) {
    const label = TIPO_LABEL[ev.tipo] || ev.tipo;
    if (!grupos.has(ev.tipo)) grupos.set(ev.tipo, { label, qtd: 0, total: 0 });
    const g = grupos.get(ev.tipo)!;
    g.qtd += 1;
    g.total += ev.valor;
  }
  const lista = [...grupos.values()];
  lista.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.label === "Agendamento") return -1;
    if (b.label === "Agendamento") return 1;
    return a.label.localeCompare(b.label, "pt-BR");
  });
  return lista;
}

function PagamentoControle({ status, valorFaltante, observacao, onSalvar }: {
  status: string; valorFaltante: number | null; observacao: string | null;
  onSalvar: (status: string, valorFaltante?: number, observacao?: string) => void;
}) {
  const [novoStatus, setNovoStatus] = useState(status);
  const [faltante, setFaltante] = useState(valorFaltante ? String(valorFaltante) : "");
  const [obs, setObs] = useState(observacao || "");

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, paddingTop: 12, borderTop: "1px solid #eef1ff" }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#6b7fa8", fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 6 }}>STATUS DE PAGAMENTO</div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        {(["pendente", "pago", "parcial"] as const).map((s) => (
          <button key={s} onClick={() => setNovoStatus(s)}
            style={{
              flex: 1, border: "none", cursor: "pointer", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 4px", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700,
              background: novoStatus === s ? STATUS_CFG[s].color : "#f0f4ff",
              color: novoStatus === s ? "#fff" : "#6b7fa8",
            }}>{STATUS_CFG[s].label}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {novoStatus === "parcial" && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <input type="number" min={0} value={faltante} onChange={(e) => setFaltante(e.target.value)} placeholder="Quanto faltou (R$)"
            style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 10px", fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 6, outline: "none" }} />
          <input value={obs} onChange={(e) => setObs(e.target.value)} placeholder="Observação (opcional)"
            style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 10px", fontSize: 12, outline: "none" }} />
        </div>
      )}
      <button onClick={() => onSalvar(novoStatus, novoStatus === "parcial" ? Number(faltante) || 0 : undefined, obs || undefined)}
        style={{ width: "100%", background: "#1a3fa8", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer" }}>
        Salvar status
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function ModuloComissoesSemanal() {
  const [semanaInicio, setSemanaInicio] = useState(getMondayISO(new Date()));
  const [semanaFim, setSemanaFim] = useState(addDaysISO(getMondayISO(new Date()), 5));
  const [linhas, setLinhas] = useState<FechamentoSemanalRow[]>([]);
  const [carregando, setCarregando] = useState(false);
  const [gerando, setGerando] = useState(false);
  const [expandido, setExpandido] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [liveTotal, setLiveTotal] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [liveMetaQtd, setLiveMetaQtd] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [liveBatida, setLiveBatida] = useState(false);
  const [liveFaltam, setLiveFaltam] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [carregandoLive, setCarregandoLive] = useState(false);

  const [historico, setHistorico] = useState<{ semanaInicio: string; semanaFim: string; total: number }[]>([]);
  const [mostrarHistorico, setMostrarHistorico] = useState(false);

  async function carregarHistorico() {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API}/comissao-semanal/historico`);
    const json = await resp.json();
    setHistorico(json.data || []);
  }

  async function carregar() {
    setCarregando(true);
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(`${API}/comissao-semanal?semanaInicio=${semanaInicio}`);
      const json = await resp.json();
      setLinhas(json.data || []);
    } finally {
      setCarregando(false);
    }
  }

  async function carregarLive() {
    setCarregandoLive(true);
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(`${API}/comissao-semanal/live?dataInicio=${semanaInicio}&dataFim=${semanaFim}`);
      const json = await resp.json();
      setLiveTotal(json.total ?? null);
      setLiveMetaQtd(json.metaQtd ?? null);
      setLiveBatida(!!json.batida);
      setLiveFaltam(json.faltam ?? null);
    } finally {
      setCarregandoLive(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { carregar(); carregarLive(); }, [semanaInicio, semanaFim]);
  useEffect(() => { carregarHistorico(); }, []);

  async function gerar() {
    setGerando(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`${API}/comissao-semanal/gerar`, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ semanaInicio, semanaFim }),
      });
      await carregar();
      await carregarLive();
      await carregarHistorico();
    } finally {
      setGerando(false);
    }
  }

  async function atualizarPagamento(id: string, status: string, valorFaltante?: number, observacao?: string) {
    await fetch(`${API}/comissao-semanal/${id}/pagamento`, {
      method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status, valorFaltante, observacao }),
    });
    await carregar();
  }

  const totalGeral = linhas.reduce((s, l) => s + l.valor_total, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#6b7fa8", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", marginBottom: 4 }}>DE</label>
          <input type="date" value={semanaInicio} onChange={(e) => setSemanaInicio(e.target.value)}
            style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", fontSize: 13, outline: "none" }} />
        </div>
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#6b7fa8", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", marginBottom: 4 }}>ATÉ</label>
          <input type="date" value={semanaFim} onChange={(e) => setSemanaFim(e.target.value)}
            style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", fontSize: 13, outline: "none" }} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#aab4d0", marginBottom: 16 }}>A soma é calculada automaticamente pro período escolhido.</div>

      <div onClick={() => setMostrarHistorico(!mostrarHistorico)} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", background: "#f0f4ff", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 12, padding: "9px 14px", marginBottom: mostrarHistorico ? 8 : 16, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: "#6b7fa8", cursor: "pointer" }}>
        <span>📜 Ver semanas anteriores (segunda a sábado)</span>
        <span>{mostrarHistorico ? "▲" : "▾"}</span>
      </div>
      {mostrarHistorico && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16, borderRadius: 14, background: "#fff", border: "1px solid #eef1ff", maxHeight: 240, overflowY: "auto" }}>
          {historico.length === 0 ? (
            <div style={{ padding: 14, color: "#6b7fa8", fontSize: 13, textAlign: "center" }}>Nenhum fechamento gerado ainda.</div>
          ) : (
            historico.map((h) => (
              <div key={h.semanaInicio} onClick={() => { setSemanaInicio(h.semanaInicio); setSemanaFim(h.semanaFim); setMostrarHistorico(false); }}
                style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 10, padding: "10px 14px", borderBottom: "1px solid #eef1ff", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#0d1b3e", fontWeight: 600 }}>{fmtDataCurta(h.semanaInicio)} até {fmtDataCurta(h.semanaFim)}</span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: "#1a3fa8" }}>{formatBRL(h.total)}</span>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{
        background: liveBatida ? "#d1fae5" : "#fef2f2",
        border: `2px solid ${liveBatida ? "#059669" : "#dc2626"}`,
        borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px 16px", marginBottom: 16,
      }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 800, color: liveBatida ? "#059669" : "#dc2626" }}>
          {carregandoLive ? "Atualizando..." : liveBatida ? "🟢 META DE EQUIPE BATIDA" : "🔴 META DE EQUIPE NÃO BATIDA"}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#0d1b3e", marginTop: 4 }}>
          {liveTotal !== null && liveMetaQtd !== null
            ? liveBatida
              ? `${liveTotal}/${liveMetaQtd} aparelhos vendidos no período`
              : `${liveTotal}/${liveMetaQtd} aparelhos — faltam ${liveFaltam} pra bater a meta`
            : "Calculando..."}
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={gerar} disabled={gerando}
        style={{ width: "100%", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1b3e, #1a3fa8)", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", marginBottom: 16 }}>
        {gerando ? "Gerando... (pode levar alguns segundos)" : "🔄 Gerar fechamento (calcula comissão por pessoa)"}
      </button>

      {carregando ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 30, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>Carregando...</div>
      ) : linhas.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 30, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>Nenhum fechamento gerado pra esse período ainda.</div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {linhas.map((l) => {
            const st = STATUS_CFG[l.status_pagamento];
            const aberto = expandido === l.id;
            const grupos = agruparEventos(l.detalhamento);
            return (
              <div key={l.id} style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 14, marginBottom: 10, border: "1px solid #eef1ff", overflow: "hidden" }}>
                <div onClick={() => setExpandido(aberto ? null : l.id)} style={{ padding: "12px 14px", cursor: "pointer", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>{l.colaboradoras?.nome} ({l.colaboradoras?.classificacao})</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>{l.detalhamento.length} lançamento(s)</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, color: "#1a3fa8" }}>{formatBRL(l.valor_total)}</div>
                    <div style={{ display: "inline-block", background: st.bg, color: st.color, borderRadius: 8, padding: "2px 8px", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>{st.label}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {aberto && (
                  <div style={{ padding: "0 14px 14px", borderTop: "1px solid #eef1ff" }}>
                    {grupos.map((g, i) => (
                      <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", padding: "8px 0", fontSize: 13, color: "#0d1b3e", borderBottom: i < grupos.length - 1 ? "1px solid #f0f4ff" : "none" }}>
                        <span>{g.label} ({g.qtd})</span>
                        <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{formatBRL(g.total)}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    <PagamentoControle status={l.status_pagamento} valorFaltante={l.valor_faltante} observacao={l.observacao_pagamento}
                      onSalvar={(status, valorFaltante, observacao) => atualizarPagamento(l.id, status, valorFaltante, observacao)} />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}

          <div style={{ background: "#0d1b3e", borderRadius: 14, padding: "16px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginTop: 16 }}>
            <span style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Total geral do período</span>
            <span style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800 }}>{formatBRL(totalGeral)}</span>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface FechamentoMensalRow {
  id: string;
  mes: string;
  colaboradora_id: string;
  combos_presencial_qtd: number;
  agendamentos_online_qtd: number;
  valor_presencial: number;
  valor_online: number;
  valor_total: number;
  status_pagamento: "pendente" | "pago" | "parcial";
  valor_faltante: number | null;
  observacao_pagamento: string | null;
  colaboradoras: { nome: string; classificacao: string };
}

function ModuloMetasMensal() {
  const [mes, setMes] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7));
  const [linhas, setLinhas] = useState<FechamentoMensalRow[]>([]);
  const [carregando, setCarregando] = useState(false);
  const [gerando, setGerando] = useState(false);
  const [metasCfg, setMetasCfg] = useState<MetasConfig | null>(null);

  async function carregar() {
    setCarregando(true);
    try {
      const [r1, r2] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/metas-mensal?mes=${mes}`).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/metas`).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      setLinhas(r1.data || []);
      setMetasCfg(r2.data || null);
    } finally {
      setCarregando(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { carregar(); }, [mes]);

  async function gerar() {
    setGerando(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`${API}/metas-mensal/gerar`, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mes }),
      });
      await carregar();
    } finally {
      setGerando(false);
    }
  }

  async function atualizarPagamento(id: string, status: string, valorFaltante?: number, observacao?: string) {
    await fetch(`${API}/metas-mensal/${id}/pagamento`, {
      method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ status, valorFaltante, observacao }),
    });
    await carregar();
  }

  const totalGeral = linhas.reduce((s, l) => s + l.valor_total, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <label style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#6b7fa8", fontWeight: 700, display: "block", marginBottom: 4 }}>MÊS</label>
      <input type="month" value={mes} onChange={(e) => setMes(e.target.value)}
        style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", fontSize: 13, outline: "none", marginBottom: 16 }} />

      <button onClick={gerar} disabled={gerando}
        style={{ width: "100%", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1b3e, #1a3fa8)", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer", marginBottom: 16 }}>
        {gerando ? "Gerando... (pode levar alguns segundos)" : "🔄 Gerar fechamento do mês"}
      </button>

      {carregando ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 30, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>Carregando...</div>
      ) : linhas.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 30, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>Nenhum fechamento gerado pra esse mês ainda.</div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {linhas.map((l) => {
            const st = STATUS_CFG[l.status_pagamento];
            const bateuPresencial = l.valor_presencial > 0;
            const bateuOnline = l.valor_online > 0;
            const metaPresencialQtd = metasCfg?.meta_presencial_baixa_qtd ?? 30;
            const metaOnlineQtd = metasCfg?.meta_online_baixa_qtd ?? 40;
            return (
              <div key={l.id} style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 14, marginBottom: 10, border: "1px solid #eef1ff", padding: 14 }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 10 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>{l.colaboradoras?.nome} ({l.colaboradoras?.classificacao})</div>
                  <div style={{ background: st.bg, color: st.color, borderRadius: 8, padding: "3px 8px", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.label}</div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ background: bateuPresencial ? "#d1fae5" : "#fef2f2", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: bateuPresencial ? "#059669" : "#dc2626" }}>
                    {bateuPresencial ? "🟢" : "🔴"} Presencial: {l.combos_presencial_qtd} combos/mês
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#0d1b3e", marginTop: 2 }}>
                    {bateuPresencial ? `Bateu a meta → recebe ${formatBRL(l.valor_presencial)}` : `Não bateu a meta de ${metaPresencialQtd} (faltam ${Math.max(0, metaPresencialQtd - l.combos_presencial_qtd)})`}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ background: bateuOnline ? "#d1fae5" : "#fef2f2", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 12px", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: bateuOnline ? "#059669" : "#dc2626" }}>
                    {bateuOnline ? "🟢" : "🔴"} Online: {l.agendamentos_online_qtd} agendamentos/mês
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#0d1b3e", marginTop: 2 }}>
                    {bateuOnline ? `Bateu a meta → recebe ${formatBRL(l.valor_online)}` : `Não bateu a meta de ${metaOnlineQtd} (faltam ${Math.max(0, metaOnlineQtd - l.agendamentos_online_qtd)})`}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ textAlign: "right", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, color: "#1a3fa8", marginBottom: 8 }}>{formatBRL(l.valor_total)}</div>

                <PagamentoControle status={l.status_pagamento} valorFaltante={l.valor_faltante} observacao={l.observacao_pagamento}
                  onSalvar={(status, valorFaltante, observacao) => atualizarPagamento(l.id, status, valorFaltante, observacao)} />
              </div>
            );
          })}

          <div style={{ background: "#0d1b3e", borderRadius: 14, padding: "16px", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginTop: 16 }}>
            <span style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>Total geral do mês</span>
            <span style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800 }}>{formatBRL(totalGeral)}</span>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ModuloConfig() {
  const [colaboradoras, setColaboradoras] = useState<Colaboradora[]>([]);
  const [metas, setMetas] = useState<MetasConfig | null>(null);
  const [precosTexto, setPrecosTexto] = useState("");
  const [precosAtuais, setPrecosAtuais] = useState<{ modelo: string; gb: string; preco_referencia: number }[]>([]);
  const [novaSenha, setNovaSenha] = useState("");
  const [salvandoMetas, setSalvandoMetas] = useState(false);
  const [salvandoPrecos, setSalvandoPrecos] = useState(false);
  const [salvandoSenha, setSalvandoSenha] = useState(false);
  const [mensagem, setMensagem] = useState("");

  async function carregar() {
    const [c, m, p] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(`${API}/colaboradoras`).then((r) => r.json()),
      fetch(`${API}/metas`).then((r) => r.json()),
      fetch(`${API}/tabela-precos-referencia`).then((r) => r.json()),
    ]);
    setColaboradoras(c.data || []);
    setMetas(m.data || null);
    setPrecosAtuais(p.data || []);
  }

  useEffect(() => { carregar(); }, []);

  async function salvarClassificacao(id: string, classificacao: string) {
    await fetch(`${API}/colaboradoras/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ classificacao }),
    });
    await carregar();
  }

  async function salvarMetas() {
    if (!metas) return;
    setSalvandoMetas(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`${API}/metas`, {
        method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(metas),
      });
      setMensagem("Metas salvas!");
      setTimeout(() => setMensagem(""), 2000);
    } finally {
      setSalvandoMetas(false);
    }
  }

  async function salvarPrecos() {
    const linhas = precosTexto.split("\n").map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((l) => {
      const [modelo, gb, preco] = l.split(";").map((x) => x.trim());
      return { modelo, gb, preco_referencia: Number((preco || "").replace(",", ".")) };
    }).filter((l) => l.modelo && l.gb && Number.isFinite(l.preco_referencia));

    if (linhas.length === 0) { setMensagem("Nenhuma linha válida encontrada."); return; }
    setSalvandoPrecos(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`${API}/tabela-precos-referencia`, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ linhas }),
      });
      setPrecosTexto("");
      setMensagem(`${linhas.length} preços salvos!`);
      setTimeout(() => setMensagem(""), 2000);
      await carregar();
    } finally {
      setSalvandoPrecos(false);
    }
  }

  async function salvarSenha() {
    if (!novaSenha) return;
    setSalvandoSenha(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`${API}/comissao-senha`, {
        method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ senha: novaSenha }),
      });
      setNovaSenha("");
      setMensagem("Senha alterada!");
      setTimeout(() => setMensagem(""), 2000);
    } finally {
      setSalvandoSenha(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {mensagem && <div style={{ background: "#d1fae5", color: "#059669", borderRadius: 10, padding: "10px 14px", marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700 }}>{mensagem}</div>}

      <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e", marginBottom: 10 }}>👤 Classificação das colaboradoras</div>
      {colaboradoras.map((c) => (
        <div key={c.id} style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 12, padding: "10px 14px", marginBottom: 6, border: "1px solid #eef1ff", display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>{c.nome}</span>
          <select value={c.classificacao} onChange={(e) => salvarClassificacao(c.id, e.target.value)}
            style={{ border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 8, padding: "6px 10px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#1a3fa8", outline: "none" }}>
            <option value="A">A</option>
            <option value="B">B</option>
            <option value="C">C</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      ))}

      <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e", margin: "20px 0 10px" }}>🎯 Metas</div>
      {metas && (
        <div style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 12, padding: 14, border: "1px solid #eef1ff" }}>
          {([
            ["meta_equipe_semanal_qtd", "Meta equipe — quantidade/semana"],
            ["meta_equipe_semanal_valor", "Meta equipe — valor por pessoa (R$)"],
            ["meta_presencial_baixa_qtd", "Presencial baixa — quantidade/mês"],
            ["meta_presencial_baixa_valor", "Presencial baixa — valor (R$, classificação A)"],
            ["meta_presencial_alta_qtd", "Presencial alta — quantidade/mês"],
            ["meta_presencial_alta_valor", "Presencial alta — valor (R$, classificação A)"],
            ["meta_online_baixa_qtd", "Online baixa — quantidade/mês"],
            ["meta_online_baixa_valor", "Online baixa — valor (R$, classificação A)"],
            ["meta_online_alta_qtd", "Online alta — quantidade/mês"],
            ["meta_online_alta_valor", "Online alta — valor (R$, classificação A)"],

          ))}
          <button onClick={salvarMetas} disabled={salvandoMetas}

export default function ComissaoFechamento() {
  const [autenticado, setAutenticado] = useState(false);
  const [senhaDigitada, setSenhaDigitada] = useState("");
  const [erroSenha, setErroSenha] = useState("");
  const [verificandoSenha, setVerificandoSenha] = useState(false);
  const [subPage, setSubPage] = useState<SubPage>("comissoes");

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem("comissao_unlocked") === "1") setAutenticado(true);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  async function entrar() {
    setVerificandoSenha(true);
    setErroSenha("");
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(`${API}/comissao-senha/verificar`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ senha: senhaDigitada }),
      });
      const json = await resp.json();
      if (json.ok) {
        setAutenticado(true);
        try { localStorage.setItem("comissao_unlocked", "1"); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      } else {
        setErroSenha("Senha incorreta.");
      }
    } catch {
      setErroSenha("Erro ao verificar senha.");
    } finally {
      setVerificandoSenha(false);
    }
  }

  function sair() {
    setAutenticado(false);
    setSenhaDigitada("");
    try { localStorage.removeItem("comissao_unlocked"); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }

  if (!autenticado) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 20, maxWidth: 400, margin: "60px auto" }}>
        <div style={{ background: "#fff", borderRadius: 20, padding: 28, border: "1px solid #d0daf5", boxShadow: "0 4px 20px rgba(26,63,168,0.08)" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 32, textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 8 }}>🔒</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e", textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 4 }}>Fechamento de Comissão</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#6b7fa8", textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 20 }}>Acesso restrito à gerência</div>
          <input
            type="password" value={senhaDigitada} onChange={(e) => setSenhaDigitada(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && entrar()}
            placeholder="Senha de acesso"
            style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 12, padding: "12px 14px", fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 12, outline: "none" }}
          />
          {erroSenha && <div style={{ color: "#dc2626", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12, textAlign: "center" }}>{erroSenha}</div>}
          <button
            onClick={entrar} disabled={verificandoSenha}
            style={{ width: "100%", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1b3e, #1a3fa8)", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px", fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer" }}
          >{verificandoSenha ? "Verificando..." : "Entrar"}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ paddingBottom: 100 }}>
      <div style={{ padding: "16px 16px 0" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>💼 Fechamento de Comissão</div>
          <button onClick={sair} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: "#6b7fa8", fontSize: 12, cursor: "pointer" }}>🔒 Sair</button>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, background: "#f0f4ff", borderRadius: 14, padding: 5, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          {[
            { id: "comissoes" as SubPage, label: "💰 Comissões" },
            { id: "metas" as SubPage, label: "🏆 Metas" },
            { id: "config" as SubPage, label: "⚙️ Config" },
          ].map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id} onClick={() => setSubPage(t.id)}
              style={{
                flex: 1, border: "none", cursor: "pointer", borderRadius: 10, padding: "9px 4px", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                background: subPage === t.id ? "#fff" : "transparent",
                color: subPage === t.id ? "#1a3fa8" : "#6b7fa8",
                boxShadow: subPage === t.id ? "0 2px 8px rgba(26,63,168,0.12)" : "none",
              }}
            >{t.label}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "0 16px" }}>
        {subPage === "comissoes" && <ModuloComissoesSemanal />}
        {subPage === "metas" && <ModuloMetasMensal />}
        {subPage === "config" && <ModuloConfig />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


##### ARQUIVO: ./artifacts/fechamento/src/pages/ComparativoPrecos.tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const PRECOS_API = "/api/gestaoclick/config/tabela-precos";

// ── Color utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const EMOJI_TO_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  "❤️": "vermelho", "❤": "vermelho", "🔴": "vermelho",
  "🖤": "preto", "⚫": "preto", "⚫️": "preto",
  "🔵": "azul", "💙": "azul", "🩵": "azul",
  "🤍": "branco", "⬜": "branco", "⬜️": "branco", "⚪": "branco", "⚪️": "branco",
  "🟢": "verde", "💚": "verde",
  "💜": "roxo", "🟣": "roxo", "🫐": "roxo",
  "🟠": "laranja", "🧡": "laranja", "🍊": "laranja",
  "🩶": "natural", "🪙": "natural",
  "🟡": "dourado", "💛": "dourado",
  "💗": "rosa", "🩷": "rosa",
};

const TEXT_COLORS: [string, string][] = [
  ["preto", "Preto"], ["preta", "Preto"], ["black", "Preto"],
  ["azul", "Azul"], ["blue", "Azul"],
  ["branco", "Branco"], ["branca", "Branco"], ["white", "Branco"],
  ["verde", "Verde"], ["green", "Verde"],
  ["roxo", "Roxo"], ["roxa", "Roxo"], ["purple", "Roxo"],
  ["lilas", "Lilás"], ["lila", "Lilás"], ["lavanda", "Lilás"],
  ["laranja", "Laranja"], ["desert", "Desert"],
  ["natural", "Natural"], ["titanio", "Titânio"], ["titanium", "Titânio"],
  ["dourado", "Dourado"], ["dourada", "Dourado"], ["gold", "Dourado"],
  ["vermelho", "Vermelho"], ["vermelha", "Vermelho"], ["red", "Vermelho"],
  ["rosa", "Rosa"], ["pink", "Rosa"], ["rose", "Rosa"],
  ["amarelo", "Amarelo"], ["amarela", "Amarelo"], ["yellow", "Amarelo"],
  ["silver", "Prata"], ["prata", "Prata"],
];

function normalizeAccents(s: string): string {
  return s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "");
}

function displayColor(raw: string): string {
  const norm = normalizeAccents(raw.toLowerCase());
  const found = TEXT_COLORS.find(([k]) => norm === k || norm.includes(k));
  return found ? found[1] : raw.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + raw.slice(1);
}

function extractColorFromLine(line: string): string | null {
  for (const [emoji, color] of Object.entries(EMOJI_TO_COLOR)) {
    if (line.includes(emoji)) return color;
  }
  const norm = normalizeAccents(line.toLowerCase());
  // longer matches first to avoid "preto" matching "preto" before "preta"
  for (const [key] of TEXT_COLORS) {
    if (new RegExp(`\\b${key}\\b`).test(norm)) return key;
  }
  return null;
}

// ── Price extraction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function extractPrice(line: string): number | null {
  // R$4.000,00 or R$4000
  const m1 = line.match(/R\$\s*([\d.]+(?:,\d{1,2})?)/i);
  if (m1) {
    const v = parseFloat(m1[1].replace(/\./g, "").replace(",", "."));
    if (v >= 100 && v <= 99999) return v;
  }
  // 4.000 or 4.000,00
  const m2 = line.match(/\b(\d{1,2}\.\d{3})(?:,\d{1,2})?\b/);
  if (m2) {
    const v = parseInt(m2[1].replace(".", ""), 10);
    if (v >= 1000) return v;
  }
  // plain 4-5 digit number
  const m3 = line.match(/\b(\d{4,5})\b/);
  if (m3) {
    const v = parseInt(m3[1], 10);
    if (v >= 1000 && v <= 99999) return v;
  }
  return null;
}

// ── Model extraction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ModelComponents {
  num: string;
  variant: string;  // "pro max" | "pro" | "plus" | "mini" | ""
  storage: string;  // GB as string, TB converted to 1024*n
}

function stripDecorators(s: string): string {
  // Remove emoji via codepoint ranges and markdown bold/italic
  return s
    .replace(/[\uD800-\uDFFF][\uD800-\uDFFF]/g, " ")  // surrogate pairs (emoji)
    .replace(/[☀-➿]/g, " ")  // misc symbols
    .replace(/️/g, "")
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1")  // *bold*
    .replace(/[()[\]]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

// Valid iPhone storage sizes in GB
const VALID_STORAGES = new Set(["64", "128", "256", "512", "1024"]);

// Non-lacrado keywords to skip in supplier lists
const NON_LACRADO_RE = /\b(cpo|refurb|recondicionado|seminovo|usado|semi[\s-]?novo|remanufaturado)\b/i;

function extractComponents(line: string): ModelComponents | null {
  const s = stripDecorators(line).toLowerCase();

  // Storage is the anchor — must be a valid iPhone size
  const storMatch = s.match(/(\d+)\s*(gb|tb)/i);
  if (!storMatch) return null;
  const storage = /tb/i.test(storMatch[2])
    ? String(parseInt(storMatch[1], 10) * 1024)
    : storMatch[1];
  if (!VALID_STORAGES.has(storage)) return null;

  // Special case: XR (no numeric model number)
  if (/\bxr\b/.test(s)) return { num: "XR", variant: "", storage };

  // Remove storage pattern before looking for model number
  const withoutStorage = s.replace(/\d+\s*(?:gb|tb)/gi, " ");

  // Model number: 1–2 digits, between 6 and 20
  const numMatch = withoutStorage.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\b/);
  if (!numMatch) return null;
  const num = numMatch[1];
  const numInt = parseInt(num, 10);
  if (numInt < 6 || numInt > 20) return null;

  let variant = "";
  if (/\bpm\b/.test(s) || /pro\s*max/.test(s)) variant = "pro max";
  else if (/pro/.test(s)) variant = "pro";
  else if (/\bair\b/.test(s)) variant = "air";
  else if (/plus/.test(s)) variant = "plus";
  else if (/mini/.test(s)) variant = "mini";

  return { num, variant, storage };
}

function componentsKey(c: ModelComponents): string {
  return `${c.num}__${c.variant}__${c.storage}`;
}

function modelDisplayName(c: ModelComponents): string {
  const v = c.variant ? ` ${c.variant.toUpperCase()}` : "";
  const gb =
    parseInt(c.storage, 10) >= 1024
      ? `${parseInt(c.storage, 10) / 1024}TB`
      : `${c.storage}GB`;
  return `iPhone ${c.num}${v} ${gb}`;
}

function isModelLine(line: string): boolean {
  const c = extractComponents(line);
  if (!c) return false;
  // Reject price lines
  if (/R\$/i.test(line)) return false;
  // Reject non-lacrado models (CPO, seminovo, etc.)
  if (NON_LACRADO_RE.test(line)) return false;
  return true;
}

// ── Parser ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface PriceEntry {
  modelKey: string;
  modelDisplay: string;
  color: string;
  price: number;
}

function parseSupplierText(text: string): PriceEntry[] {
  const lines = text.split("\n").map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const entries: PriceEntry[] = [];

  let currentKey = "";
  let currentDisplay = "";
  let pendingColors: string[] = [];
  let pendingPrice: number | null = null;

  for (const line of lines) {
    if (isModelLine(line)) {
      const c = extractComponents(line)!;
      currentKey = componentsKey(c);
      currentDisplay = modelDisplayName(c);
      pendingColors = [];
      pendingPrice = null;
      continue;
    }

    // CPO/non-lacrado marker on a line after the model header → discard model
    if (NON_LACRADO_RE.test(line) && currentKey) {
      currentKey = "";
      currentDisplay = "";
      pendingColors = [];
      pendingPrice = null;
      continue;
    }

    if (!currentKey) continue;

    const color = extractColorFromLine(line);
    const price = extractPrice(line);

    if (color && price) {
      pendingColors = [];
      pendingPrice = null;
      entries.push({ modelKey: currentKey, modelDisplay: currentDisplay, color, price });
    } else if (color && !price) {
      if (pendingPrice !== null) {
        // Price appeared before color (e.g. ◾️R$6850 / ◾️AZUL)
        entries.push({ modelKey: currentKey, modelDisplay: currentDisplay, color, price: pendingPrice });
        pendingPrice = null;
      } else {
        pendingColors.push(color);
      }
    } else if (!color && price) {
      if (pendingColors.length > 0) {
        // One price for multiple accumulated colors
        for (const c of pendingColors) {
          entries.push({ modelKey: currentKey, modelDisplay: currentDisplay, color: c, price });
        }
        pendingColors = [];
      } else {
        // Price with no color yet — wait for color on next line
        pendingPrice = price;
      }
    }
  }

  return entries;
}

// ── My-table parser (multi-line WhatsApp format) ──────────────────────────────
// Model header line, then optional per-color price lines or a single price line.
// color="" means no specific color listed → matches all colors found in suppliers.

interface MyEntry {
  modelKey: string;
  modelDisplay: string;
  color: string;
  price: number | null;
}

function parseMyTable(text: string): MyEntry[] {
  const lines = text.split("\n").map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const entries: MyEntry[] = [];

  let currentComps: ModelComponents | null = null;
  let modelHasColorEntries = false;

  for (const line of lines) {
    const comps = extractComponents(line);
    if (comps && !extractPrice(line)) {
      currentComps = comps;
      modelHasColorEntries = false;
      continue;
    }

    if (!currentComps) continue;

    const color = extractColorFromLine(line);
    const price = extractPrice(line);

    if (color && price) {
      const key = componentsKey(currentComps) + "__" + color;
      if (!entries.find((e) => e.modelKey + "__" + e.color === key)) {
        entries.push({ modelKey: componentsKey(currentComps), modelDisplay: modelDisplayName(currentComps), color, price });
      }
      modelHasColorEntries = true;
    } else if (!color && price && !modelHasColorEntries) {
      // Single price with no color → wildcard (will match any color found in suppliers)
      const key = componentsKey(currentComps) + "__";
      if (!entries.find((e) => e.modelKey + "__" + e.color === key)) {
        entries.push({ modelKey: componentsKey(currentComps), modelDisplay: modelDisplayName(currentComps), color: "", price });
      }
      modelHasColorEntries = true;
    }
  }

  return entries;
}

// ── Merging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface MergedRow {
  modelKey: string;
  modelDisplay: string;
  color: string;
  p1: number | null;
  p2: number | null;
  p3: number | null;
  media: number;
  sugestao: number;
  minha: number | null;
  diff: number | null;
}

function mergeEntries(
  e1: PriceEntry[],
  e2: PriceEntry[],
  e3: PriceEntry[],
  minha: MyEntry[]
): MergedRow[] {
  const find = (entries: PriceEntry[], modelKey: string, color: string) => {
    const m = entries.find((e) => e.modelKey === modelKey && e.color === color);
    return m ? m.price : null;
  };

  const rows: MergedRow[] = [];

  function pushRow(modelKey: string, modelDisplay: string, color: string, minhaPrice: number | null) {
    const p1 = find(e1, modelKey, color);
    const p2 = find(e2, modelKey, color);
    const p3 = find(e3, modelKey, color);
    const prices = [p1, p2, p3].filter((p): p is number => p !== null);
    if (prices.length === 0) return;
    const media = prices.reduce((s, p) => s + p, 0) / prices.length;
    const sugestao = Math.round((media + 300) / 10) * 10;
    const diff = minhaPrice !== null ? minhaPrice - sugestao : null;
    rows.push({ modelKey, modelDisplay, color, p1, p2, p3, media, sugestao, minha: minhaPrice, diff });
  }

  // Only iterate models from MINHA TABELA — not from suppliers
  for (const item of minha) {
    if (item.color === "") {
      // Wildcard: expand to all colors found across suppliers for this model
      const allColors = new Set<string>();
      for (const list of [e1, e2, e3]) {
        for (const e of list) {
          if (e.modelKey === item.modelKey) allColors.add(e.color);
        }
      }
      for (const color of allColors) {
        pushRow(item.modelKey, item.modelDisplay, color, item.price);
      }
    } else {
      pushRow(item.modelKey, item.modelDisplay, item.color, item.price);
    }
  }

  rows.sort((a, b) => a.modelDisplay.localeCompare(b.modelDisplay) || a.color.localeCompare(b.color));
  return rows;
}

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function ComparativoPrecos() {
  const [texts, setTexts] = useState({ f1: "", f2: "", f3: "", minha: "" });
  const [names, setNames] = useState({ f1: "Fornecedor 1", f2: "Fornecedor 2", f3: "Fornecedor 3" });
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<MergedRow[]>([]);
  const [view, setView] = useState<"input" | "result">("input");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Load persisted names and minha tabela from server on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(PRECOS_API)
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j) => {
        if (j.data?.nomes) setNames(j.data.nomes);
        if (j.data?.minhaTabela) setTexts((prev) => ({ ...prev, minha: j.data.minhaTabela }));
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  function processar() {
    setError("");
    // Persist names and minha tabela to server
    fetch(PRECOS_API, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ data: { nomes: names, minhaTabela: texts.minha } }),
    }).catch(() => {});

    try {
      const e1 = parseSupplierText(texts.f1);
      const e2 = parseSupplierText(texts.f2);
      const e3 = parseSupplierText(texts.f3);
      const em = parseMyTable(texts.minha);

      const merged = mergeEntries(e1, e2, e3, em);

      if (merged.length === 0) {
        setError(
          "Nenhum modelo encontrado. Verifique se a Minha Tabela tem o modelo em uma linha e o preço (com ou sem cor) nas linhas seguintes."
        );
        return;
      }

      setRows(merged);
      setView("result");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(String(err));
    }
  }

  function gerarMensagem() {
    return rows
      .map((r) => `${r.modelDisplay} ${displayColor(r.color)} - R$${r.sugestao.toLocaleString("pt-BR")}`)
      .join("\n");
  }

  function copiar() {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(gerarMensagem()).then(() => {
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    });
  }

  const fmtBRL = (n: number | null) =>
    n === null ? "—" : `R$${n.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}`;

  // ── Result view ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if (view === "result") {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: "16px", maxWidth: 600, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 80 }}>
        <button
          onClick={() => setView("input")}
          style={{
            background: "#f0f4ff", border: "none", borderRadius: 10,
            padding: "8px 16px", color: "#0d1b3e", fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer",
            marginBottom: 16, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6,
          }}
        >
          ← Voltar
        </button>

        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>
            💰 {rows.length} modelos
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={copiar}
            style={{
              background: copied ? "#059669" : "#1a3fa8", color: "#fff", border: "none",
              borderRadius: 12, padding: "10px 16px", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, cursor: "pointer",
            }}
          >
            {copied ? "✓ Copiado!" : "📋 Copiar Lista"}
          </button>
        </div>

        {rows.map((r, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              background: "#fff", borderRadius: 14, padding: "14px 16px",
              marginBottom: 10, boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)",
              border: "1px solid #e8eeff",
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "flex-start", marginBottom: 10 }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>{r.modelDisplay}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#6b7fa8", marginTop: 2 }}>{displayColor(r.color)}</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ textAlign: "right" as const }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#6b7fa8", letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>PREÇO SUGERIDO</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: "#1a3fa8" }}>
                  R${r.sugestao.toLocaleString("pt-BR")}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(4, 1fr)", gap: 6 }}>
              {[
                { label: names.f1, val: r.p1 },
                { label: names.f2, val: r.p2 },
                { label: names.f3, val: r.p3 },
                { label: "Média", val: r.media },
              ].map(({ label, val }, j) => (
                <div
                  key={j}
                  style={{
                    background: "#f8faff", borderRadius: 10, padding: "8px 6px",
                    textAlign: "center" as const,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 9, color: "#6b7fa8", fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 3, letterSpacing: "0.05em" }}>
                    {label.toUpperCase().slice(0, 12)}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: val !== null ? "#0d1b3e" : "#d0d8f0" }}>
                    {fmtBRL(val !== null ? Math.round(val) : null)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {r.minha !== null && (
              <div
                style={{
                  marginTop: 10, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center",
                  padding: "8px 12px", borderRadius: 10,
                  background: (r.diff ?? 0) > 0 ? "#f0fdf4" : (r.diff ?? 0) < 0 ? "#fef2f2" : "#f0f4ff",
                  border: `1px solid ${(r.diff ?? 0) > 0 ? "#bbf7d0" : (r.diff ?? 0) < 0 ? "#fecaca" : "#d0daf5"}`,
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>Minha tabela atual</div>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12, alignItems: "center" }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#0d1b3e" }}>{fmtBRL(r.minha)}</span>
                  <span
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700,
                      color: (r.diff ?? 0) > 0 ? "#059669" : (r.diff ?? 0) < 0 ? "#dc2626" : "#6b7fa8",
                    }}
                  >
                    {(r.diff ?? 0) > 0 ? `+${fmtBRL(r.diff)}` : fmtBRL(r.diff)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Input view ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const supplierFields = [
    { key: "f1" as const, placeholder: "Cole aqui a lista do Fornecedor 1...\n\nEx:\n♻️IPHONE 16 128GB *INDIANO*\n◾️PRETO ◾️R$4050\n◾️AZUL ◾️R$4100" },
    { key: "f2" as const, placeholder: "Cole aqui a lista do Fornecedor 2..." },
    { key: "f3" as const, placeholder: "Cole aqui a lista do Fornecedor 3..." },
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "16px", maxWidth: 600, margin: "0 auto", paddingBottom: 80 }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 800, color: "#0d1b3e", marginBottom: 4 }}>
        💰 Comparativo de Preços
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#6b7fa8", marginBottom: 20 }}>
        Cole as listas dos fornecedores no formato WhatsApp. O sistema reconhece modelo, cor e preço automaticamente.
        O preço sugerido é a média + R$300.
      </div>

      {supplierFields.map(({ key, placeholder }) => (
        <div key={key} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, marginBottom: 6 }}>
            <input
              value={names[key]}
              onChange={(e) => setNames((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: e.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Nome do fornecedor"
              style={{
                flex: 1, background: "#f0f4ff", border: "1px solid #d0daf5",
                borderRadius: 10, padding: "8px 12px", fontSize: 13, color: "#0d1b3e", outline: "none",
              }}
            />
            {texts[key] && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setTexts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: "" }))}
                style={{ background: "none", border: "none", color: "#aab4d0", fontSize: 16, cursor: "pointer", padding: "4px 8px" }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <textarea
            value={texts[key]}
            onChange={(e) => setTexts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: e.target.value }))}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            rows={6}
            style={{
              width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" as const, background: "#fff",
              border: "1px solid #d0daf5", borderRadius: 12, padding: "12px",
              fontSize: 12, color: "#0d1b3e", fontFamily: "monospace",
              resize: "vertical" as const, outline: "none",
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* Minha Tabela */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: "#0d1b3e", marginBottom: 6 }}>
          🏷 Minha Tabela Atual <span style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 400, color: "#6b7fa8" }}>(opcional)</span>
        </div>
        <textarea
          value={texts.minha}
          onChange={(e) => setTexts((prev) => ({ ...prev, minha: e.target.value }))}
          placeholder="Cole aqui sua tabela atual para ver a diferença em relação ao preço sugerido..."
          rows={6}
          style={{
            width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box" as const, background: "#fff",
            border: "2px solid #1a3fa8", borderRadius: 12, padding: "12px",
            fontSize: 12, color: "#0d1b3e", fontFamily: "monospace",
            resize: "vertical" as const, outline: "none",
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div
          style={{
            background: "#fef2f2", border: "1px solid #fecaca", borderRadius: 12,
            padding: "12px 16px", marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 13, color: "#dc2626",
          }}
        >
          ⚠️ {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <button
        onClick={processar}
        style={{
          width: "100%", background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1a3fa8, #2d5be3)",
          color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 14, padding: "16px",
          fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 800, cursor: "pointer",
          boxShadow: "0 4px 16px rgba(26,63,168,0.3)",
        }}
      >
        💰 Processar Comparativo
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
